ghent.trial_scope: Current organizer material describes dog carcinoma and fluorescence-guided resection, but the title and body do not establish the same cohort boundaries.
ghent.proposed_disposition: Preserve as a separate pending therapeutic lead.

barc.finding: Sponsor labels the Palladia-naive canine randomized fecal transplant or placebo study Active Enrollment. All receive standard Palladia. Primary descriptions emphasize GI tolerability; they do not say the study pays for or gives separate access to Palladia.

milan.finding: OPBA 82 2022 exact phase I/II OncoFAP-MMAE for PAF-positive spontaneous canine cancers without suitable standard options; University of Milan Lodi. Official page covers study biopsy, scans, four infusions and tests; unrelated testing owner-paid. No dated confirmation of current intake found.

budapest.finding: Sponsor still displays a notice that it temporarily cannot accept applications. A separate old invitation for up to 20 vaccinated dogs does not override it. No exact canonical selection record found; no activation.

uq.finding: Two experimental vaccine formulations in dogs with appendicular osteosarcoma, no detectable metastasis, proceeding to surgery, UQ. Current third-party highlight and UQ pages refer to the same protocol, originally announced in July 2023.

brazil.finding: FAPESP 26/07298-5 funding dates reflect a functional drug-sensitivity assay project, not a therapeutic enrollment cutoff or a new open treatment.

jasmine.finding: JASMINE names new radiotherapy for canine nasal adenocarcinoma at Azabu and Nihon Universities; neither exact scope or independent current slots confirmed. The separate JVCOG diffuse large B-cell lymphoma option is explicitly paused.

nvlu.finding: Canine implanted BCNU glioma study population has a published research period ending March 31, 2026, with no current recruiting invitation or exact canonical record found. Separate survivin vaccine listing still shows March 31, 2027.

bologna.finding: The official listing marks all three displayed dog cancer cohorts concluded: appendicular osteosarcoma, malignant melanoma and visceral/cardiac hemangiosarcoma. Do not translate three closed old listings into three new closures of matcher cards.

ensenada.finding: Current reading of November 3 UNAM research article confirms same Ensenada silver nanoparticle Argovit in dogs and cats; reported cases are not prospectively open protocol eligibility, complete cost/site coverage or dated intake.
